subject: Runtime handoff & staffing proposal for isolated-hosting feasibility
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: Runtime handoff & staffing proposal for isolated-hosting feasibility

Team —

Acme Health wants a Private (VPC + on-prem option) pilot but their procurement timeline is tight (they want a signed SOW by end of December). Product has flagged a set of runtime integration asks that we need to validate:

- deterministic KV cache eviction policy for multi-tenant isolation
- quantized model variants for 8-bit target on their DGX fleet
- logging/minimal telemetry that satisfies their SOC/arch team (no egress PII)

Marissa: can you confirm whether the current runtime can surface the eviction hooks and whether there are any kernel/backward-compat issues for the quantized path?
Soojin: I need a staffing ask from infra — rough T-shirt estimate (S, M, L) and which roles (infra eng, runtime, SRE) we need to commit to pilot + first 90 days of ops.

I attached a short SOW draft and a runtime notes PDF. I propose a 30-minute sync today to align on a recommended decision we can present to Sales to share with Acme.

Thanks —
Karthik
Director, Product & Strategy
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Runtime handoff & staffing proposal for isolated-hosting feasibility

Karthik —

Quick answers from runtime:
- KV cache eviction: runtime supports prefix-based and time-based eviction today. We don't expose a hook to let user code select eviction strategy per-tenant, but we can add a metadata toggle. Estimate: 1 week of focused runtime work + 2 days of testing (S).
- Quantized model variants: we have a 4-bit/8-bit path that runs on Ampere and Hopper families; DGX (NVIDIA) on-prem will need a small kernel path tweak for mixed-FP16/INT8 fallback for stability. Estimate: M — 3 weeks eng + 1 week validation.
- Telemetry: we can produce a minimal telemetry bundle (token counts, error rates, no raw prompts) — requires minor changes to redaction pipeline. Estimate: 3 days.

Blocking concerns: we need a secure artifact distribution path for quantized weights to their air-gapped environment (this triggers legal/procurement questions).

I'll join sync.

— Marissa
Staff Engineer, Runtime
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T10:38:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Runtime handoff & staffing proposal for isolated-hosting feasibility

Karthik/Marissa —

Rough staffing ask for pilot + 90 days ops (minimal viable support):
- Runtime Eng: 1 FTE (sprint-focused) for the 3-week quantization work, 1 FTE half-time for the eviction toggle and telemetry changes (combined M).
- Infra/SRE: 1.5 FTEs (oncall rotation + deployment automation) for pilot duration; 1 FTE for the first 90 days of support afterwards.
- Security/Compliance (part-time): 0.2 FTE for artifact handling and SOC evidence (light).
- Solutions Eng / Customer Eng: 0.5 FTE for onboarding, config, and acceptance testing.

Risks & notes:
- Kernel tweak for DGX may require vendor debug time; plan for potential 1-week contingency.
- Artifact distribution to air-gapped environments requires a signed transfer process + HSM integration request from Acme. Legal will need to sign off.

Estimated cost banding: $80k–$140k for the initial pilot engineering/resourcing (not including licensing/cloud credits).

If Sales needs a faster yes, we can propose a scoped pilot that excludes on-prem quantized path (hosted or VPC-only) to reduce M -> S.

— Soojin
VP Engineering, Infrastructure
From: Clara Benson <clara@acme-health.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Health Procurement <procurement@acme-health.com>, Ben Mulroney <ben@partnercloud.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T11:50:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Runtime handoff & staffing proposal for isolated-hosting feasibility

Karthik/Soojin/Marissa —

Thanks for the quick breakdown. A few clarifications from our side:
- The timeline is firm: we need a signed SOW by 2026-12-29 to start our fiscal Q1 onboarding.
- We need the DGX path for on-prem (our models are tuned for that hardware). If that is a blocker, please outline a fallback plan in the SOW (VPC-only with a later on-prem phase).
- For artifact transfer: our security team requires an audit trail and transport encryption with a customer-maintained key. Ben from PartnerCloud will assist on the transport pattern.

Can you provide a short decision matrix (S/M/L) and the fallback plan by EOD Tuesday (2026-11-23)? Procurement is standing by for the SOW.

Best,
Clara
Head of Platform Integrations
Acme Health
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Clara Benson <clara@acme-health.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Ben Mulroney <ben@partnercloud.com>, Acme Health Procurement <procurement@acme-health.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T14:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Runtime handoff & staffing proposal for isolated-hosting feasibility

Clara —

We can deliver a clear decision matrix and fallback plan by EOD Tuesday. Summary for Procurement to review now:

Option A (Recommended, M): Full pilot including DGX quantized path – requires kernel tweak + runtime work. Staff ask: Runtime Eng (1.5 FTE total), Infra/SRE (1.5 FTE), Solutions Eng (0.5), Security (0.2). Timeline to pilot readiness: ~6 weeks.

Option B (Conservative, S): VPC-only pilot (no on-prem kernels) – avoids DGX kernel work. Staff ask: Runtime Eng (0.8 FTE), Infra (1 FTE). Timeline: ~3 weeks.

Fallback: Phase 1 VPC-only acceptance + Phase 2 on-prem quantized integration (schedule TBD, dependent on artifact transfer and kernel support).

I'll attach an updated SOW draft with both Option A/B and a short appendix describing artifact transfer controls for review.

Planned next step: internal sign-off on resourcing and go/no-go by Monday EOD in order to get the SOW final for Procurement.

Thanks —
Karthik
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Clara Benson <clara@acme-health.com>, Ben Mulroney <ben@partnercloud.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Runtime handoff & staffing proposal for isolated-hosting feasibility

Quick internal note:

Leadership is comfortable approving Option B (VPC-first) as the default external-facing offer to Acme pending an explicit timeline for Phase 2. The ask from Leadership: include a clear milestone for the DGX kernel work and a contingency escalation path (who to loop in if vendor debug exceeds 2 weeks).

I'll update the SOW to reflect Option B as the default and add a Phase 2 appendix. Please review the updated SOW when I share it (ETA EOD Monday).

— Stephanie
VP Product Ops
